name: Attribute Sheet
description: STR/DEX/INT and everything derived from them. progression.xp_leveling owns the moment of growth — the level-up event and the points it grants; this sheet owns where those points land and what they mean: the raw attributes, the derived stats (carry weight, crit chance, check modifiers), and the check roll itself. Owning the roll here matters because dialogue, traps, and combat all ask the same question — does 14 DEX beat difficulty 12? — and the answer must come from one implementation of the dice or the game lies to somebody. It does not own what a passed check unlocks; the asker decides, which is what keeps the sheet usable by every system that checks. Attribute allocation now has explicit restored and unspent state. Build Respec may request a full or selected allocation reset; the sheet returns attribute points separately from skill points and acknowledges its transaction id. It still owns derived stats and checks, never skill ranks or respec pricing. The sheet now exposes that check as a synchronous query with a restorable deterministic roll cursor, allowing dialogue and other callers to replay the same seed and request sequence without moving dice rules into the caller.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: attributeNames
inputs.description: The attribute set. Six is the tabletop inheritance; fewer is fine, but the check consumers must agree with this list.

inputs.name: pointsPerLevel
inputs.description: Attribute points granted per level-up. One keeps every level a real decision; three turns leveling into shopping.

inputs.name: checkDieSides
inputs.description: Die rolled for checks. d20 by convention: flat, swingy, and legible to anyone who has ever held one.

inputs.name: derivedStatTable
inputs.description: Formulas mapping attributes to derived stats, as data. Data so that rebalancing derived stats never touches the roller.

inputs.name: baseAttributes
inputs.description: Unmodifiable starting value for each attribute. Empty uses the host's existing default for each declared name.

inputs.name: initialAttributes
inputs.description: Restored allocated values by attribute name, including any base value. Restore is not a purchase and is not revalidated against a revised curve.

inputs.name: initialUnspentPoints
inputs.description: Restored unspent attribute points. Null derives the allowance from level history for a fresh sheet.

inputs.name: checkSeed
inputs.description: Seed for the deterministic check stream when a check request does not supply an explicit roll. The same seed, attributes, difficulties, and request sequence reproduce the same results.

inputs.name: initialCheckCount
inputs.description: Restored number of deterministic check rolls already consumed. Restoring the cursor prevents a reload from rerolling the same upcoming check.

outputs.name: derivedStats
outputs.description: Computed derived values, refreshed on any attribute change.

outputs.name: unspentPoints
outputs.description: Attribute points available for new allocations.

outputs.name: investedPoints
outputs.description: Attribute points currently allocated above base values.

outputs.name: planRespec
outputs.description: Pure query returning the allocations and attribute-point refund affected by a requested reset.

outputs.name: check
outputs.description: check({attribute, difficulty, roll?}): synchronously returns {passed, roll, total, difficulty, checkCount}. An explicit roll is validated against checkDieSides and does not advance the deterministic stream; otherwise the next seeded roll is used. The caller owns the consequence.

outputs.name: checkCount
outputs.description: Deterministic rolls consumed so far; restore this with initialCheckCount.
